title: Sonic R (Demo)
overview:
This Time, Sonic Is... Racing? Rapid? Running? Rush?

Retire? No way. Zoom along and race for the goal!!

Grand Prix Mode
Take on the "World Grand Prix" to decide who is the fastest in the world!!

2P Versus Mode
Player 1 vs. Player 2 versus races on a top-and-bottom split screen are OK too!!

Time Attack Mode
Along with regular time attack, there is balloon popping and tag too!!

こんどのソニックはRacing? Rapid? Running? Rush?

Retireなんてゴメンだね。ビュンビュン走ってゴールをめざせ!!

グランプリモード
世界で一番速いヤツ決定戦『ワールドグランプリ』にチャレンジ!!

2P対戦モード
上下2分割画面で、プレイヤー1vsプレイヤー2の対戦レースもOK!!

タイムアタックモード
ふつうのタイムアタックはもちろん、バルーン割りに鬼ごっこもアリ!!
